info.description: The routes between chat providers and the receiver, with JSON bodies. Paths are relative to the base address the caller is configured with, and a service may mount them under a prefix of its own. Any other method and path is answered 404 `no-route` in the error shape. A route a service serves of its own beside these answers 404 `nothing-held` where it keeps nothing at the address its path names, so a caller tells an empty address from a wrong path by `code`. A refusal is an answer: a send the provider does not perform is answered 200 with a typed refusal. A caller offers a request again only when the connection was refused, so a request that reached a listener is never made twice.
